sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Receivables vs. Revenue Growth: Days sales outstanding moved +40 days over 5 years while revenue compounded 30.5%. Receivables are growing faster than sales, which can flatter revenue recognition and must be watched.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 21.8 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +4.2% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 0.8% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 1 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 61 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
